note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1949: 20 nominations for the 31 seats and no contest; the eleven retiring members not nominated were deemed to be re-elected. The list prints no party labels. Returned unopposed. Robert H. Abraham: no party label printed in 1949. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Killyman, 25 May 1939, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1939, p. 3 ("Rural Council Changes"); Killyman, 5 June 1958, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 23 May 1958, p. 4 ("Only Rural Contest in Clady")).
